what: Erasing from the cursor to the end of the screen (ED, ESC[J) with the cursor at the top-left corner is a clear of the whole screen to tmux, which pushes the screen into its history first: a region redrawn that way left a copy of itself in the scrollback every frame whenever it started on the pane's first row.
cost: an hour; found only in the history capture
fix: the encoder erases the last region a row at a time (EL) and the reference terminal of blaze-screen's tests refuses ED
